summary: Authorize exact same-repository integration heads, recover cached build publication, and retain only the current and rollback production builds.

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild of application data.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Developer-only deployment scripts. An explicit trust mode is required: an author allowlist or repository collaborator write, maintain or admin permission. Fork and moved PR heads cannot run as integration candidates.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change. Cached successful builds can retry publication after an activation failure.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners configure the trust mode and its required inputs before adopting these scripts.

recovery.detail: Application data is unchanged. After successful activation, deployment build retention preserves the current build and one previous rollback build and removes older build directories.
